About OPortals

A place to explore philosophy
with everyday life in view.

OPortals is a place to explore philosophy for everyday life, with illustrated books at its heart. We welcome curious readers navigating attention, relationships, uncertainty and the choices that make up a day. We publish our original writing under the OPortals name. Each inspired-by guide identifies its source author and distinguishes the original work from our commentary.

Who creates our books ↗Contact us ↗

Each book pairs philosophical questions with original illustrations and practical reflection. What you take from it is personal; no particular result is promised.

Before you choose a book

A few practical answers.

Are these physical or digital books?

Digital PDFs in English. No physical book or shipping is included. The format and known page count appear on each book’s page.

Can I see inside before buying?

Yes. Read the free sample and actual page previews. SneakPeak Ideas is a free collection, with no payment or subscription required.

Can I buy a book right now?

Yes. Life Secrets is available through PayPal. Read its four-page sample before you buy. The Art of Attention, Lead Without the Noise and Man and People also have their own PayPal checkout. Books in development cannot be purchased. SneakPeak Ideas is free.

How will I receive a paid book?

Digital books are PDF downloads. Life Secrets is available through PayPal for $7.99 USD. Return after payment to verify your transaction and download the PDF. Each available paid book has its own PayPal checkout. Return after payment to verify your transaction and download the book you purchased.

What does “Inspired by” mean?

An independent OPortals interpretation with original wording and illustrations. It credits the source author, reproduces no source passages or modern translations, and does not claim affiliation or endorsement.

What if I have trouble with a file or payment?

Contact us with the book title and a description of the problem. Do not send card details or passwords. See Digital products & refunds for access and support information.
